purpose: Initial implementation candidate catalog for NW-13 planning; eligibility is not an implementation or adoption claim.

policy.authoring: Backend-neutral semantics; concrete GPU mechanisms are compiler/export choices.
policy.common_profile: Retain the agreed common non-RTX implementations and separately exported fallback artifacts. A common implementation need not reproduce a historical algorithm.
policy.allowed_neural_use: Fixed vendor-supplied, production-independent pretrained inference without fitting model weights or latents to nodewerk content.
policy.ordinary_state: Sampling, cache updates and temporal accumulation are not neural training; their state/reset behavior still needs definition.
policy.adoption: Choose a useful workload and apply existing NW-11/NW-13 validation policy. Eligibility alone does not select an integration or require all candidates in NW-13.
policy.costs: Account for required SDK/runtime/model dependencies and memory. Use only explicit artifact-specific size requirements, without introducing universal byte gates.
policy.hardware: Query the concrete API, shader-model, driver and feature requirements. A GPU marketing name is not a capability test. Many candidates use ordinary compute rather than RT/Tensor cores.

candidates.role: Geometry generation, processing and culling before rasterization.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Can replace geometry execution stages, not modeling functions, topology, selections or UV authoring.

candidates.role: Scene intersections for shadows, reflections and selected visibility queries.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Requires actual geometry, materials, lights and shading. Intersection support alone is not scene-aware reflected radiance.

candidates.role: GPU-created work for a selected bounded procedural or stateful workload.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Scheduling implementation; does not replace the authored generation or simulation semantics.

candidates.role: Reservoir resampling for selected direct or indirect lighting workloads; assess DI, GI and PT variants separately.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Sampling strategy within a renderer, not a replacement for authored lights or materials.
Low-frequency diffuse signal with temporal response and memory costs; not complete GI or a replacement for sharp reflections.

candidates.role: Spatially hashed radiance cache populated and reused by a path-traced lighting workload.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Caches sampled radiance; updates are not neural training. Requires a suitable renderer and declared cache response.

candidates.role: Non-neural spatio-temporal denoising of compatible noisy signals.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Not an artistic blur, bloom, distortion or feedback replacement; select a denoiser for its supported signal.

candidates.role: Super Resolution or native-resolution anti-aliasing using vendor-trained models.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Image reconstruction, not procedural texture generation or material authoring.

candidates.role: Reconstruction of noisy ray-traced image signals using vendor-trained models.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Can replace compatible denoising stages. Does not create scene geometry, lights or authored post effects.

candidates.role: Frame Generation and Multi Frame Generation are separately capability-qualified presentation options.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Generated presentation frames do not advance simulation, authored animation or the authoritative audio clock. They are not additional native-rendered frames in evidence.

candidates.role: NRC learns scene radiance while rendering.
candidates.replacement_boundary: A ready SDK still performs online training; this conflicts with the agreed policy.

candidates.role: NTC or neural material variants that optimize weights or latents for the production's assets.
candidates.replacement_boundary: Exclusion applies to the fitting-dependent integration. A different fixed, production-independent pretrained technique would require a separate eligibility assessment.

candidates.role: Execution infrastructure for an explicitly eligible fixed pretrained-inference workload.
candidates.replacement_boundary: The execution API is not itself a model or an authoring capability. Do not adopt it without a permitted concrete workload.

candidates.role: Independently evaluate applicable execution reordering, opacity and dense-geometry/displacement acceleration techniques.
candidates.replacement_boundary: No new authoring semantics. Historical technology names, including Micro-Mesh, do not establish current D3D12/toolchain availability; verify each concrete API before selecting it.
